channel.title: QuotePlace — Quote of the Day
channel.description: One quote, every day, chosen deterministically from the QuotePlace collection.

item.title: Seneca — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-26
item.description: “Sometimes even to live is an act of courage.” — Seneca

item.title: Mahatma Gandhi — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-25
item.description: “It is the quality of our work which will please God, not the quantity.” — Mahatma Gandhi

item.title: Helen Keller — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-24
item.description: “Keep yourself to the sunshine and you cannot see the shadow.” — Helen Keller

item.title: Bhagat Singh — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-23
item.description: “They may kill me, but they cannot kill my ideas.” — Bhagat Singh

item.title: Simon Sinek — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-22
item.description: “Working hard for something we don't care about is called stress; working hard for something we love is called passion.” — Simon Sinek

item.title: Sun Tzu — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-21
item.description: “Speed is the essence of war. Take advantage of the enemy's unpreparedness; travel by unexpected routes and strike him where he has taken no precautions.” — Sun Tzu

item.title: Aristotle — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-20
item.description: “It is possible to fail in many ways, while to succeed is possible only in one way.” — Aristotle

item.title: Kahlil Gibran — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-19
item.description: “Give your hearts, but not into each other's keeping. For only the hand of Life can contain your hearts.” — Kahlil Gibran
